tagline: Behavioral changes Starting with this release, new streaming queries in real time mode use real time watermark propagation by default.
what_it_does: Behavioral changes Starting with this release, new streaming queries in real time mode use real time watermark propagation by default. Stateful operators advance the event time watermark within a batch, so late events are filtered against the live watermark and state is evicted sooner than before. Queries restarted from an existing checkpoint keep their original behavior.
why_it_matters: Bug fixes Operating system security updates and miscellaneous fixes.
